scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('apps/server/public'))if(f!=='.gitkeep')fs.rmSync('apps/server/public/'+f,{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm --filter @yunidesk/dashboard build && pnpm --filter @yunidesk/widget build
scripts.release: pnpm -r --filter yunidesk --filter yunidesk-react --filter yunidesk-react-native publish --access public
